organization.name: Gauntlet Group
organization.description: Gauntlet Group designs and implements AI-powered IT automations for growing businesses — alert triage, helpdesk workflows, employee onboarding, and custom integrations using Microsoft 365, Azure, n8n, and more.

services.name: AI Alert Triage
services.description: Automated triage and routing of IT alerts. Alerts are classified, deduplicated, and routed to the right team in roughly 3 seconds end-to-end.

services.name: IT Helpdesk Automation
services.description: Automated handling of common helpdesk requests such as password resets, handled without a single support ticket.

services.name: Employee Onboarding
services.description: Automated onboarding of new starters — accounts, access, and welcome email ready on day one in seconds.

services.name: AI Support Assistants
services.description: RAG-based AI assistants that answer questions from your own documentation, available 24/7 with no extra headcount.

services.name: Custom Workflows
services.description: Bespoke automation of any process that involves copying data or waiting for a human. Any tool, any process.

services.name: WEEE & IT Asset Disposal
services.description: Secure, certified, zero-to-landfill IT asset recycling and disposal.
